description: I am  from Annamacharya University, Rajampeta, building Twin Earth: a tool that uses real NASA data to find places on Earth most like Moon and Mars base sites (Shackleton, Jezero, Gale), so astronauts know where to train. We've got AI and coding covered. Looking for someone with planetary/Earth science, stats/data viz, or video/storytelling skills. Just be curious about space. Message us!
